title: COPPA (US children under 13)
appliesWhen: The product is directed to children under 13 in the US, or knowingly collects their personal information.
ask: Is the product aimed at children, or could children under 13 sign up?

gates.title: Age screening and verifiable parental consent
gates.architecture: Record the age gate and the parental consent method before any personal information of a child is collected.
acceptance: No personal information is collected from a user identified as under 13 before verifiable parental consent

gates.title: Children's privacy notice and consent method need legal review
